# Known hosting / colo ranges. BMCs live disproportionately in colo and bare-metal
# providers, so these produce far more ASRock Rack hits than residential space.
# Ranges drift over time - asns.txt re-derives fresh ones from BGP data every week.
# Big clouds (AWS/Azure/GCP) are partially covered on purpose: full coverage makes
# a cycle enormous.
